final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ID AS id, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS r FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.id AS id, s1.r AS r, s1.r - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.r > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.id AS id, s3.r AS r, s3.d AS d, s3.r - s4.m AS e FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.m) SELECT AVG(r), AVG(d), AVG(e) FROM s5
